native.limits: Native AI-versus-AI illustration, not human play or a strength comparison. The recording duration13:53 is not an observed match victory. High-resolution mode is verified through supported UI/reload/rendered appearance; no native per-frame HD counter is exposed by MCP.

native.timing: The later stills are paused at tick20078, independently recorded as the initial paused tick of the subsequently started native video. The earlier town still records only its visible replay clock3:16; exact tick was not exported.

qualityProof.method: Actual native MCP UI. Settings Display & graphics: switched Software → SDL GPU, selected Artwork → High resolution, then loaded a fresh replay and re-opened Settings to verify the applied selection remained High resolution. No code/state injection.
qualityProof.renderer: SDL GPU, runtime texture-filtering capability proved by enabled Artwork choice and actual backend change/viewport transition.
qualityProof.choice: Explicit High resolution (not Automatic); retained native preferences report rendererBackend=sdl-gpu, highResolutionArtworkChoice=on and highResolutionArtwork=1.
sourceContract: src/ui/settings/SettingsScreenGeneral.cpp: artwork requires textureFiltering; explicit High resolution is never adapted.
libs/gag/src/Sprite.cpp: Software only draws original artwork, filtering backends support high-resolution frames.
qualityProof.limits: Native MCP does not expose per-frame HD draw counters. Qualification uses actual supported explicit setting, fresh-load application, capable active backend and independently reviewed rendered appearance, not loaded-pack readiness alone. Earlier Software candidates remain held.

resourceResolution.qualification: Source-supported resolution, not a per-file runtime trace. Exact released FileManager constructor searches the isolated profile, then Apple SDL_GetBasePath (bundle Resources), before GLOB2_ASSET_DIR, runtime assets, working directory and source roots. The isolated profile has no data/artwork override. Captured MCP/logs do not expose resolved resource roots. The prior process has closed; no live open-file verification was obtained.
resourceResolution.publicationStatus: Source-supported resolution qualification accepted by coordinator and reciprocal reviewer; no per-file path trace claimed.

motion.speed: Actual supported replay speed control set to0 (normal1x) before recording; no temporal rescaling. Dropped-frame count describes recording, not a performance benchmark.
